subject: Routing: AWS private-offer pricing & buyer approval steps for Acme Diagnostics
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acme-diag.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS private-offer pricing & buyer approval steps for Acme Diagnostics

Hi Sarah — great to connect last week. Per our conversation, Acme is prioritizing a private-offer path on AWS Marketplace so procurement can buy via their internal SSO/PO flow. Quick summary of what we can offer and what we need from your side: 

- Proposed term: 12 months (we can discuss 6-month pilot if you need a shorter initial commitment)
- Suggested commercial: 25% off list with a $150k committed spend threshold (scales to 30% at $300k)
- Buyer approval gating: buyer procurement needs to sign the private-offer via AWS console; we also need a PO or signed confirmation from Acme procurement for finance.

Can you confirm: the internal approver(s) and whether Acme requires any specific invoice cadence (monthly vs. annual) or PO number format? Also, can you share the RFP PDF and any SOC2/KMS requirements so we can route the compliance request to Security?

I’ve looped in Vanessa (pricing & marketplace ops) and AWS Marketplace Sales to help with the private-offer creation. Happy to jump on a short call to walk through the steps.

Best,
Elliot
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.ai
Attachments: (none)
From: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acme-diag.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private-offer pricing & buyer approval steps for Acme Diagnostics

Thanks Elliot — moving this to procurement. A few clarifying items from my side: 

- Term: Procurement prefers 12 months but will sometimes accept a 9-month pilot if there is an auto-renew and cancellation window.
- Approvals: final sign-off comes from our Head of Procurement (L. Gomez) and our Finance Ops team; they require the AWS private-offer link + a formal PO.
- Security: we’ll need proof of SOC2 Type II and confirmation on data residency (we keep EU & US clouds separated; Acme will require US hosting for this workload).
- Invoicing: prefer quarterly invoices if possible.

Attached is the RFP excerpt with our commercial scoring criteria and the internal approver list. Can you share a proposed private-offer term sheet we can feed to Procurement?

-Sarah
Sarah Blake
Director, Procurement
Acme Diagnostics
Attachments: Acme_Diagnostics_RFP.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS private-offer pricing & buyer approval steps for Acme Diagnostics

Elliot — forwarding Sarah's notes. Quick internal checklist and recommendation: 

- Compliance: Ask Security for SOC2 Type II report and confirm US-only hosting option; Priyom, can you pull the latest SOC2 artifacts and cert notes?
- Pricing/tenor exception: Given Acme’s scale and pilot needs, recommend 12 months with a 30-day cancellation window after month 9 (to accommodate pilot-to-prod decisions). We can offer 25% off list at $150k commit or 30% at $300k commit.
- Approval routing: AWS private-offer typically requires buyer to accept in the console and upload PO. For exceptions (eg: procurement wants invoice-first), Finance will need to approve a deferred billing path. Karthik, can you confirm constraints from finance (quarterly invoices OK?)

Action items: 
- Priyom: attach SOW-template.docx and SOC2 stub to send externally once legal signs off.
- Karthik: confirm if quarterly invoicing and PO-number-only flow are acceptable from Finance.
- Elliot: draft a short private-offer term sheet (one-pager) we can send to Sarah + AWS contact, highlight buyer-approval steps.

Thanks — Vanessa

Attachments: SOW-template.docx
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acme-diag.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private-offer pricing & buyer approval steps for Acme Diagnostics

Sarah — thanks for the details. Below is the proposed private-offer summary we can place into the AWS console; once you confirm Acme’s PO cadence and approver emails we’ll ask AWS to provision the private-offer link for procurement acceptance.

Proposed private-offer term sheet (summary):
- Term: 12 months (option: 9-month pilot with auto-renew to 12 months; cancellation allowed with 30-day notice after month 9)
- Commercial: 25% off Redwood list pricing at $150k committed ARR; 30% off at $300k committed ARR
- Invoicing: default annual invoice; Redwood Finance can support quarterly invoicing on a case-by-case basis (requires Finance approval and PO upload before first invoice)
- Buyer approval flow: Acme procurement accepts private-offer link in AWS Marketplace console + uploads PO (or sends signed confirmation to aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com). Acceptance triggers entitlements.
- Compliance: Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II artifacts and confirm US-region hosting for this subscription.

Next steps: 
1) Sarah: confirm approver emails for L. Gomez + Finance Ops contact and preferred invoice cadence (confirm quarterly vs. annual).
2) Redwood: Vanessa/Priyom to deliver SOC2 stub and SOW-template; Karthik to confirm Finance sign-off for quarterly invoices.
3) AWS Marketplace Sales: please create the private-offer draft in Marketplace and share the offer link back to this thread.

I’ll follow up once I have the approver emails — earliest is tomorrow. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
